## Core Services & Capabilities
1. **Balcony Safety Nets:** High-tenacity HDPE netting for child and pet safety. 200kg/m² load-tested. 5-year warranty.
2. **Bird & Pigeon Nets:** Transparent and HDPE UV-stabilized mesh for anti-pigeon protection in apartments and commercial buildings.
3. **SS316 Invisible Grills:** Marine-grade high-tensile 316 stainless steel cables for unobstructed balcony safety.
4. **Sports & Cricket Practice Nets:** Custom-dimension box cricket courts, school practice pitches, and ball stop netting.
5. **Turnkey Football & Cricket Turf Construction:** Sub-base preparation, FIFA-standard artificial grass, MS cages, and 200+ Lux LED floodlighting.
6. **Ceiling Cloth Drying Hangers:** Pulley-operated rust-proof stainless steel pipe drying systems.
